name: io.github.seokhoonj/kis-trader
title: KIS Trader
description: MCP server for the Korea Investment & Securities (KIS) Open API with guarded live orders.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: Install kis-trader with the optional MCP extra, then run the package's entry point: a uvx launcher resolves the identifier 'kis-trader' to the MCP server console script (full launch: uvx --from "kis-trader[mcp]" kis-trader). When invoking by hand the 'kis-mcp' alias is equivalent.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: KIS Open API app key. Alternatively set KIS_MCP_PROFILE to a saved profile that already holds the credentials (then this is not needed).

environmentVariables.name: KIS_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: KIS Open API app secret. Alternatively set KIS_MCP_PROFILE to a saved profile that already holds the credentials (then this is not needed).

environmentVariables.name: KIS_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Account number in CANO-ACNT form, e.g. 12345678-01. Alternatively set KIS_MCP_PROFILE to a saved profile that already holds the account (then this is not needed).

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Name of a saved kis-trader profile to load credentials from, instead of KIS_APP_KEY/KIS_APP_SECRET/KIS_ACCOUNT.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: Trading environment. 'paper' uses the KIS simulation server; 'real' routes to the live server and additionally requires the real-order gates below.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_ALLOW_REAL
environmentVariables.description: First gate for live orders: set to '1' to permit real-order placement when KIS_MCP_ENVIRONMENT=real. Unset keeps live orders blocked.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_REAL_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: Second gate for live orders: an explicit confirmation phrase required alongside KIS_MCP_ALLOW_REAL before a real order is transmitted.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_SYMBOL_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated symbols permitted for live placement and modify. Required for any real order: unset or empty blocks all live orders (no allow-all). Cancel is exempt (it reduces exposure).

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_MAX_ORDER_QTY
environmentVariables.description: Fat-finger cap: maximum quantity per live order (RiskLimits). A domestic real place/modify requires a domestic size cap (this or KIS_MCP_MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL); an overseas real place/modify additionally requires the matching KIS_MCP_MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL_<CCY>. Without the applicable cap the order is refused fail-closed.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL
environmentVariables.description: Fat-finger cap: maximum notional (price x quantity) per live DOMESTIC (KRW) order (RiskLimits). Overseas orders use the per-currency KIS_MCP_MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL_<CCY> caps instead; a domestic real order requires one of the domestic SIZE caps (this or MAX_ORDER_QTY) -- the price collar is not a size cap and does not satisfy the gate.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL_<CCY>
environmentVariables.description: Fat-finger cap for overseas orders: maximum notional per live order in the exchange's risk-check currency (for example KIS_MCP_MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL_USD). Required for any real overseas place/modify -- without the matching currency cap the order is refused fail-closed.

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_PRICE_COLLAR_PCT
environmentVariables.description: Fat-finger cap: maximum allowed deviation of the limit price from the reference price, in percent (RiskLimits collar).

environmentVariables.name: KIS_MCP_MAX_REAL_ORDERS
environmentVariables.description: Session circuit breaker: maximum number of live orders per server session before it halts and refuses further live place/modify orders until restarted. Cancels are exempt -- they do not consume a slot and remain available while halted (so positions can be exited).
